DESCRIPTION: Caution mark: muted-red outlined triangle with a short vertical exclamation stroke and a dot inside. Outline only, no fill.

DESCRIPTION: Compact binary diagram for SH03: small mug, two thin branch lines and two blank rounded label plates, drawn as one group that can be removed in a single operation.

NOTES: Baked as one group precisely because the plan's strongest beat is removing all of it at once.

DESCRIPTION: Connector arrow: thin black hand-drawn curved stroke ending in a small open arrowhead. Two mirrored versions (mug to left figure, mug to right figure). Supplied as complete strokes - no segmented variants needed.

DESCRIPTION: Response arcs: small muted-red arcs in the style of a single sound-wave stroke. Supplied as a 1-arc version and a 3-arc stacked version, same stroke weight and spacing in both.
NOTES: Unlabelled by requirement: no numbers, no scale, no diagnosis, no ECG tracing. The arcs count, they do not measure.
